subject: Evaluation onboarding roster & network topology requests for private VPC trial
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: James Fisher <james.fisher@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:03:00Z
Subject: Draft eval & onboarding roster for private VPC eval

James —

Thanks again for agreeing to run the private VPC evaluation with us. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a compact network checklist to accelerate the infra review. At a high level we propose the following milestones and owners: 

- Week 0 (Dec 6): Design review — network topology & VPN approach (Acme network owner + Redwood netops)
- Week 1 (Dec 13): Access & IAM/KMS proof points — KMS key owner + IAM roles tested
- Week 2 (Dec 20): Private deploy smoke test in staging VPC (short load + SLO verification)
- Week 3 (Dec 27): Evaluation wrap, performance notes, and go/no-go decision

Immediate asks from your side so we can lock dates:
- Name and email for your networking owner (VPN/peering)
- KMS/contact who can coordinate key policy and SCIM/IAM mapping
- Any constraints on egress/corp proxy or dedicated NAT that would affect topology

Attachments: RW-Acme_MAP-draft.pdf, network-checklist.xlsx

I propose a 30-minute design review on Tue Dec 8 or Wed Dec 9 to walk topology and any firewall/NAT constraints. If either of those works for you please suggest times — otherwise I can send an availability poll.

Thanks,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: James Fisher <james.fisher@acmecloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T17:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft eval & onboarding roster for private VPC eval

Vivek —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Networking owner: Leah Ortiz (leah.ortiz@acmecloud.com) — she handles our VPN/SD-WAN and peering work.
- KMS contact: I can loop our infra security lead, but short-term I recommend you work with myself + Leah and I'll introduce the key owner during the design review.
- Egress: we do run through a corporate proxy for outbound, but we can open dedicated NAT paths for vendor workloads if we know IP ranges and destination domains.

Either Dec 8 at 10:00am PT or Dec 9 at 11:00am PT works for Leah and me — please pick one.

Also: can you call out baseline telemetry we should expect during the staging smoke test? CPU/GPU utilization, latency percentiles, and token throughput would be great.

Thanks,
James Fisher
Senior Platform Engineer, Acme Cloud

On 2026-12-01T15:03:00Z Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> James —
> 
> Thanks again for agreeing to run the private VPC evaluation with us. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a compact network checklist to accelerate the infra review. At a high level we propose the following milestones and owners: ...
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:05:00Z
Subject: Internal owners for Acme MAP and next steps

Team —

Quick internal alignment after Vivek's note and James' reply:
- Networking/VPN owner: assign Ben to coordinate network-level questions and collate IP/NAT details we need to share. Ben — please sync with Leah (Acme).
- KMS & IAM owner: Monica will own key policy, CMK setup, and SCIM mapping for the trial. Monica — can you confirm whether we need an HSM-backed key for their compliance?
- Procurement/backstop: I'll review contract milestone language and confirm the short-term trial credit we offered.

Ben: network-checklist.xlsx is attached to the external MAP; please prepare answers for Dec 8 design review. Monica: attach the internal-owner-roster.docx with any required artifacts (SAML metadata, KMS key policy template).

We should keep the design review tightly scoped: topology + VPN approach + KMS alignment (30 minutes). Vivek, please lock the time on Dec 8 at 10:00am PT with Acme and send calendar invite + dial-in & short agenda.

Hannah
Director, Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal owners for Acme MAP and next steps

Got it — I'll own KMS/IAM for the eval. Quick notes:
- We prefer to use a customer-controlled KMS key where possible; if Acme requires HSM-backed keys we'll capture that as a blocker and escalate.
- Required artifacts from Acme: principal/certificate for peering endpoints (if mutual TLS), SAML metadata for SCIM (if provisioning), and any IP allowlist for KMS API calls.
- I'll upload a KMS key policy template to the internal roster doc and share a short checklist by EOD.

Monica
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: James Fisher <james.fisher@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@acmecloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T16:00:00Z
Subject: Confirming design review — Dec 8 10:00am PT + pre-reads

James/Leah —

Confirmed: design review Tuesday Dec 8 at 10:00am PT (30 minutes). Calendar invite is sent (see related link). Agenda: 1) topology & peering approach (10m), 2) VPN/NAT constraints (10m), 3) KMS/IAM checklist & artifacts (10m).

Pre-reads uploaded here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-MAP-draft (RW-Acme_MAP-draft.pdf). Please review network-checklist.xlsx before the call — Ben will lead the topology discussion. Monica will cover KMS requirements and expected artifacts.

Action items before the meeting:
- James: confirm whether you will provide an HSM-backed key option or prefer customer-managed CMK.
- Leah: share peering endpoint IPs or expected CIDR ranges if available.
- Ben: prepare the short packet on NAT and egress expectations (2 slides).
- Monica: attach KMS checklist to the internal roster and share link.

Thanks — looking forward to a productive review.

Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
